speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, it's two o'clock in the morning.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Why is everybody keep telling me what time it is?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You, the president of the university, his wife, their sullen teenage daughter. That entire family is fascinated by what time it is and whether people know it.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You went to President Seibert's house in the middle of the night?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: He didn't respond to my e-mail, his phone number is unlisted. Tell me what my other option was.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You could have waited until morning. I know, look who I'm talking to.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Do you remember the grant proposal I submitted to the National Science Foundation to detect slow-moving monopoles at the magnetic North Pole?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hardly a day goes by when I don't think about it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Aw, how nice. Well, a space opened up at the last minute on the NSF expedition to the Arctic Circle.
